title: ADR-0146 修订里「32 种已登记类型」过时（主干已 33 种）
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Found by zone a4-S while building #37200, and noted as N1 in the contract review on PR #37219 (7152914447).

## What

ADR-0146's amendment still says "32 registered types". Since `ai_context` (#37173) was registered, main has 33, and ADR-0084's tier table (merged in #37219) lists 33 rows. Change the count, or replace the number with a pointer to ADR-0084's table so it cannot drift again.

## Done when

ADR-0146 states no stale count. Nothing else changes.

## Notes

- `docs/adr/**` is a governed path, so this goes Tier H to the maintainer.
- Size XS.
- It can ride with the next ADR edit in this epic.
